scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome.
Honorable Knight,
would you like to rent
a Peco Peco? The rental
fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临，尊敬的骑士。
要租一只大嘴鸟吗？租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but these
Peco Pecos are only
available for Knights
and Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
很抱歉，大嘴鸟仅供骑士和骑士领主租用。

scripts.text: Rent Peco Peco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鸟

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
Are you...
bankrupt?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您的Zeny不足。
您该不会...破产了吧？

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but you're
not eligible for this
service. Please go learn
the Peco Peco Ride skill first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
很抱歉，您不符合
使用本服务的条件。
请先学习骑乘术。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You're already
mounted on a
Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您已经骑着大嘴鸟了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
请先解除商城坐骑。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I see.
Well then,
have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
明白了，祝您今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Crusader.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临，十字军。
我们为您准备了特别的大嘴鸟，租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Paladin.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临，圣殿十字军。
我们为您准备了特别的大嘴鸟，租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
What can I do for you?
Please be aware that
this Peco Peco rental
service is strictly for
Crusaders and Paladins.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
有什么可以帮您的吗？
请注意，这项大嘴鸟租赁服务仅供十字军和圣殿十字军使用。

scripts.text: Rent a PecoPeco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鸟

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
If you would like
a Peco Peco please
bring {0} zeny...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您的Zeny不够，想租大嘴鸟，请准备{0} Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You must first learn
to ride a PecoPeco before
I can rent one to you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
在您学会骑乘大嘴鸟之前，
我无法将大嘴鸟租给您。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You are already
mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您已经骑着大嘴鸟了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
请先解除商城坐骑。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
See you around.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...得先解除战狼，才能租猎鹰！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Do you need a Falcon?
You can rent your own
trusty bird of prey for a
fee of just {0} zeny~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
需要猎鹰吗？
只要{0} Zeny，就能租到一只可靠的猛禽伙伴~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Young fool!
Falcons can only
be used by Hunters
and Snipers, capish?
...Heh heh, jealous?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
傻小子！只有猎人和神射手才能使用猎鹰，懂吗？
...Heh heh，羡慕吧？

scripts.text: Rent Falcon
scripts.translation: 租猎鹰

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...得先解除战狼，才能租猎鹰！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
What is this?
You don't have
enough zeny?!
You better start
hunting money
instead of monsters~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
什么？Zeny不够？！
先别忙着打魔物，去赚点钱吧~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Gosh~
Go learn how to
manage a Falcon
first! I can't rent one
to you if you can't
handle it, you know.
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
哎呀~先学会驾驭猎鹰吧！
您不会使用，我可不能租给您。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You already have
a Falcon. It's right
there, can't you see it?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...您已经有猎鹰了，就在那儿，没看见吗？

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
W-wait, where're
you goin'? These
Falcons are top notch,
I guarantee it! C'mon, yo~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
等...等等，您要去哪儿？
这些猎鹰都是顶尖的，我保证！来嘛~
